digest.component_or_area: code review criteria routing and threshold calibration
propositions: Two model-emitted criteria synonyms (sec→security, documentation→docs) are absent from the packaged routing index and incorrectly fall to the default 0.95 threshold instead of their criterion's tuned threshold.
The criteria dimension vocabulary is open by design and project-supplied criteria are first-class; a fixed enum constraint on criteria is architecturally wrong and must not be introduced.

Normalize criteria labels against the effective vocabulary (project overlay included, never the packaged index alone) by mapping synonyms before threshold lookup in code_review_decide, leaving all other labels and open dimensions unchanged.

The calibration document embeds five errors: mischaracterizing sec/documentation as non-tunable, computing security/docs rows on truncated samples, proposing project.review-phase-boundaries at wrong threshold, mis-stating and under-listing data-hygiene labels, and omitting that the script reads no routing index.
After documentation→docs normalization, findings with impact > 0 must surface (not be suppressed) and those with impact ≤ 0 must be dropped, demonstrating impact-aware nit-suppression behavior.
